summary: Calisa Acquisition Corp, a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting subscription agreements entered into on July 31, 2026, with three accredited investors, including sponsor Calisa Holding LP, for 800,000 Class A ordinary shares at $10.00 per share, raising $8 million in aggregate gross proceeds. The issuance is contingent upon and substantially concurrent with the closing of its merger with Goodvision AI Inc. under the previously announced Business Combination Agreement. This is a PIPE-style financing in connection with the de-SPAC transaction, not a standalone special situation. The shares are sold under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D/S exemptions. Registration rights agreements were also executed. What to watch: closing conditions and merger consummation timing.
